region.bloodsea.bones.sub: Everyone the sea ever took is here
region.bloodsea.leviathan.sub: Something below is as large as the dark
region.bloodsea.edge.sub: The sea ends. It does not stop.
region.bloodsea.mirage.sub: Not everything you see is there
sky.bloodsea.sun.sub: It sees everything. Lies show in its light. Do not look back at it.
sky.bloodsea.moon.sub: The sea is hungry. It will feed you, if you go into it.
ending.bloodsea.label: Ending %s of %s
ending.bloodsea.bone.title: Acceptance
ending.bloodsea.bone.0: The Bone Gatherer took one more.
ending.bloodsea.bone.1: Its crown has a new skull now, facing the empty sea.
ending.bloodsea.bone.2: Somewhere, a woman still leaves a light on in the window.
ending.bloodsea.leviathan.title: Return
ending.bloodsea.leviathan.0: The trawler Margaret found him three days after the storm.
ending.bloodsea.leviathan.1: He had been floating on a hatch cover. The cat had kept him awake.
ending.bloodsea.leviathan.2: He never told anyone about the red sea.
ending.bloodsea.leviathan.3: But he never let Pip out of his sight again.
ending.bloodsea.edge.title: The Fall
ending.bloodsea.edge.1: The sea pours past him into a dark that has no bottom.
ending.bloodsea.edge.2: He has forgotten Anna's face. He is forgetting his own.
ending.bloodsea.edge.3: He is not dreaming any more. He is not anything.
ending.bloodsea.mirage.title: The Stomach
ending.bloodsea.mirage.1: Something in the Blood Sea keeps what it eats alive, and dreaming.
ending.bloodsea.mirage.2: He is still in the white room. Pip is still on his bed.
ending.bloodsea.mirage.3: He is happy. That is the cruelest part.
subtitles.bloodsea.wake_lunge: Something rises out of the blood
subtitles.bloodsea.watcher_stare: The sun is looking at you
line.bloodsea.wake.2: Is that... blood? All of it?
line.bloodsea.wake.3: Hey. Hey, easy. Where did you come from?
line.bloodsea.wake.4: You look at me like you know me.
line.bloodsea.wake.5: I'll call you Pip. Is that alright? Pip.
line.bloodsea.wake.6: A map. Someone drew this. Four places, and an X, right where we are.
line.bloodsea.wake.7: Okay. Okay. First things first. The oar.
line.bloodsea.rule.1: Pip, get back from the edge!
line.bloodsea.rule.3: Whatever happens, we never touch that water. Never.
line.bloodsea.think.hungry: My stomach is eating itself. There has to be something floating out here.
line.bloodsea.think.crate: Ship's biscuits. Somebody's cargo. Somebody's ship.
line.bloodsea.think.row: Sit at the oar. Row. Just row.
line.bloodsea.think.night: It's so dark. Stay close, Pip.
line.bloodsea.think.north: The map shows islands to the north. Islands drawn like bones. Fine. North.
line.bloodsea.think.east: That sound. Like a heart. It's coming from the east.
line.bloodsea.think.west: There's a light in the west. A lighthouse? Out here?
line.bloodsea.gift.2: For me? You caught that, for me?
line.bloodsea.gift.share: Half for you, half for me. That's fair.
line.bloodsea.gift.keep: Sorry, little one. I need it more than you.
line.bloodsea.moon.2: Come here, Pip. Stay close to me tonight.
line.bloodsea.bump.1: Something hit us. Something under the raft.
line.bloodsea.bump.look: God. It's long. It's so long.
line.bloodsea.bump.quiet: Shh. Shh. It'll go. It has to go.
line.bloodsea.bump.shout: Get away from us! Get away!
line.bloodsea.dawn.1: Morning. We made it through, Pip. We made it.
line.bloodsea.mem1.1: Elias, don't go out tonight. Look at the sky. It's wrong.
line.bloodsea.mem1.2: One more trip, Anna. The nets are already out.
line.bloodsea.mem1.3: Then take that cat of yours. She's been crying at the door all night.
line.bloodsea.mem1.5: And you. You were with me. You were always with me.
line.bloodsea.eye.away: Don't look at it. Just row.
line.bloodsea.eye.stare: Go on, then. Look. I'm still here.
line.bloodsea.bones.2: They're people. All of them. People.
line.bloodsea.mem2.1: Elias! Grab the line! Grab the line!
line.bloodsea.mem2.3: She's going down! Get off the boat!
line.bloodsea.mem2.4: The storm. There was a storm.
line.bloodsea.voice.2: Elias, it's me. I'm here. I'm right here.
line.bloodsea.voice.real: You're not her. She's at home. You're not her.
line.bloodsea.taken.1: Pip... Pip... come here, little one.
line.bloodsea.taken.2: Pip? Pip, no. Come here. Come back to me.
line.bloodsea.taken.5: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I should have held you.
line.bloodsea.dest.hope: The light. If there's a light, there's someone. There has to be.
line.bloodsea.dest.accept: The bones. I know where I belong now.
line.bloodsea.dest.courage: The heartbeat. Whatever it is, I'm going through it.
line.bloodsea.dest.fury: To the end of it. To the very end.
line.bloodsea.mirage.3: The light... it's so bright... I can't...
line.bloodsea.hosp.1: Mister Hart? Mister Hart, can you hear me?
line.bloodsea.hosp.3: Saint Mary's. A fishing boat found you three days ago. You're safe now.
line.bloodsea.hosp.4: Pip? Pip, you're here. You're alive.
line.bloodsea.hosp.5: That cat hasn't left your bed since they brought you in.
line.bloodsea.hosp.6: I dreamt there was a sea. A sea of blood. The sun had an eye. And something took you, Pip. It took you.
line.bloodsea.hosp.7: It was just a dream. Just a dream.
line.bloodsea.throne.2: No boat found me. There was only the water.
line.bloodsea.throne.3: I never came home, Anna. I'm sorry.
line.bloodsea.maw.1: Alright. Whatever you are. Take me through.
line.bloodsea.rescue.1: There! Man in the water! Get the hook!
line.bloodsea.rescue.2: I've got you, I've got you! Breathe, mate. Breathe!
line.bloodsea.rescue.4: Your cat? She's on the hatch cover. Been yowling at us for an hour. Wouldn't let us leave.
line.bloodsea.rescue.5: Pip. You kept me alive. You kept me alive.
line.bloodsea.edge.2: If this is a dream, I'm done dreaming.
choiceq.bloodsea.gift: A fish. Pip is watching you.
choiceq.bloodsea.eye: The sun is looking at you.
choiceq.bloodsea.lev: It is right in front of you.
choiceq.bloodsea.voice: The voice is calling your name.
obj.bloodsea.oar: Sit at the oar at the back of the raft.
obj.bloodsea.food: You are starving. Row to a floating crate and pull it aboard.
obj.bloodsea.night: Survive the night. Stay on the raft.
obj.bloodsea.north: Row north, to the islands drawn like bones.
obj.bloodsea.dest_hope: Row to the lighthouse in the west.
obj.bloodsea.dest_accept: Row north, to the throne of bones.
obj.bloodsea.dest_courage: Row east, into the heart of it. The Maw.
obj.bloodsea.dest_fury: Row south, to the end of the sea.
